feed.title: Acme Semiconductors beats revenue guidance on record chip demand
feed.body: Acme Semiconductors reported quarterly revenue that beat guidance, driven by record demand for its data-center chips. The company raised its full-year outlook. Globex Motors said it expects stable supply of Acme components through next year.

feed.title: Acme Semiconductors beats revenue guidance on record chip demand
feed.body: Acme Semiconductors reported quarterly revenue that beat guidance, driven by record demand for its data-center chips. The company raised its full-year outlook. Globex Motors said it expects stable supply of Acme components through next year.

feed.title: Helix Cloud said to be eyeing Acme
feed.body: Helix Cloud is reportedly considering an acquisition of Acme Semiconductors, according to people familiar with the matter. Neither company commented.

feed.title: Globex Motors recalls 40,000 vehicles
feed.body: Globex Motors announced a recall of 40,000 vehicles after a safety investigation found a braking defect. Analysts downgraded Globex and warned of higher warranty costs.

feed.title: Globex Motors CEO publishes apology letter
feed.body: Globex Motors chief executive Dana Reyes published an open letter apologising to customers for the braking defect. The board said an internal review is under way.

archive.title: Regulator opens probe into braking defect
archive.body: A federal regulator opened an investigation into Globex Motors over the braking defect.

archive.title: Globex Motors CEO to step down
archive.body: Globex Motors said chief executive Dana Reyes will step down at the end of the month. The announcement comes days after the apology letter.

archive.title: Globex Motors appoints new CEO
archive.body: Globex Motors named Sam Patel as its new CEO, effective immediately.

archive.title: Globex chief Dana Reyes steps down
archive.body: Globex Motors chief executive Dana Reyes steps down, days after her apology letter to customers.

archive.title: Globex Motors announces leadership transition
archive.body: Globex Motors today announced that Dana Reyes will step down as chief executive officer at the end of the month. The board has begun a search for her replacement.
